newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenyang Chemical set to issue 80 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Shenyang Chemical set to issue 80 mln A shares.

text.p: Shenyang Chemical Industry Co Ltd is due to launch an initial public offering of 80 million A shares via the Shenzhen bourse automated quotation system soon, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Thursday.
The offer, priced at 6.4 yuan per share, would have a price/earnings ratio of 15 times based on the firm's forecast profits for this year, the newspaper said.
The domestic currency A shares are slated for listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, it said. Other details on the company would be made public in a prospectus to be released soon, it said.
